plan: Psalm 1:1-6; Psalm 2:1-12; Psalm 10:1-18; Psalm 33:1-22; Psalm 71:1-24; Psalm 91:1-16

readings.title: The Two Ways
readings.subtitle: The man who delights in the Torah of YeHoVaH is blessed.
readings.text: [Psalm 1:1] Blessed is the man who shall not walk in the counsel of the wrong, And shall not stand in the path of sinners, And shall not sit in the seat of scoffers, [2] But <dn>his</dn> delight is in the Torah of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, And <dn>he</dn> meditates in <dn>His</dn> Torah day and night. [3] For <dn>he</dn> shall be as a tree Planted by the rivers of water, That yields <dn>את</dn> its fruit in its season, And whose leaf does not wither, And whatever <dn>he</dn> does prospers.

readings.title: The Fate of the Wrong
readings.subtitle: They are like chaff which the wind blows away.
readings.text: [Psalm 1:4] The wrong are not so, But are like the chaff which the wind blows away. [5] Therefore the wrong shall not rise in the judgment, Nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous. [6] For <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> knows <dn>את</dn> the way of the righteous, But the way of the wrong comes to naught.

readings.title: The Rebellion of the Nations
readings.subtitle: The rulers take counsel together against YeHoVaH and His Messiah.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:1] Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate emptiness? [2] The sovereigns of the earth take their stand, And the rulers take counsel together, Against <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> and against <dn>His</dn> Messiah, and say, [3] <dq>“Let us tear apart <dn>את</dn> Their bonds, And throw away <dn>את</dn> Their ropes from us.”</dq>

readings.title: The Sovereign's Decree
readings.subtitle: He who is sitting in the heavens laughs.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:4] <dn>He</dn> who is sitting in the heavens laughs, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> mocks at them. [5] Then <dn>He</dn> speaks to them in <dn>His</dn> wrath, And troubles them in <dn>His</dn> rage, saying, [6] <dq>“But <dn>I</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have set <dn>My</dn> Sovereign on Tsiyon, <dn>My</dn> set-apart mountain.”</dq>

readings.title: The Son's Inheritance
readings.subtitle: Ask of Me, and I make the nations Your inheritance.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:7] <dq>“<dn>I</dn> inscribe for a law: <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has said to <dn>Me</dn>, ‘<dn>You</dn> are <dn>My</dn> Son, Today <dn>I</dn> have brought <dn>You</dn> forth.</dq> [8] <dq>Ask of <dn>Me</dn>, and <dn>I</dn> make the nations <dn>Your</dn> inheritance, And the ends of the earth <dn>Your</dn> possession.</dq> [9] <dq>Break <dn>את</dn> them with a rod of iron, Dash <dn>את</dn> them to pieces like a potter’s vessel.’ ”</dq>

readings.title: A Call to Wisdom
readings.subtitle: Serve YeHoVaH with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
readings.text: [Psalm 2:10] And now, be wise, O sovereigns; Be instructed, you rulers of the earth. [11] Serve <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with fear, And rejoice with trembling. [12] Kiss the Chosen, lest <dn>He</dn> be enraged, And you perish in the way, For soon <dn>His</dn> wrath is to be kindled. Blessed are all those taking refuge in <dn>Him</dn>.

readings.title: The Arrogance of the Wicked
readings.subtitle: Why do You stand afar off, O YeHoVaH?
readings.text: [Psalm 10:1] Lamed Why do <dn>You</dn> stand afar off, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, hiding in times of distress? [2] In arrogance the wrongdoer hotly pursues the poor; They are caught by the schemes which they devised. [3] For the wrongdoer boasted of his cravings; And the greedy one cursed and despised <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>. [4] In the pride of his face The wrongdoer does not seek <dn>Him</dn>, In all his thoughts there is no <dn>Elohim</dn>! [5] <dn>His</dn> ways are always prosperous! <dn>Your</dn> right-rulings are on high, out of his sight! <dn>He</dn> snorts at all his adversaries! [6] <dn>He</dn> has said in his heart, “<dn>I</dn> shall not be moved; From generation to generation, never be in evil!”

readings.title: The Plots of the Wicked
readings.subtitle: He has said in his heart, 'Ěl has forgotten.'
readings.text: [Psalm 10:7] Pě <dn>His</dn> mouth is filled with cursing and deceit and oppression; Under his tongue is trouble and wickedness. [8] <dn>He</dn> sits in the hiding places of the villages; In the secret places <dn>he</dn> kills the innocent; Ayin <dn>His</dn> eyes are on the lookout for the helpless. [9] <dn>He</dn> lies in wait in a secret place, as a lion in his den; <dn>He</dn> lies in wait to catch the poor; <dn>He</dn> catches the poor, drawing him into his net. [10] And <dn>he</dn> crouches, <dn>he</dn> lies low, And the helpless fall under his strength. [11] <dn>He</dn> has said in his heart, “<dn>Ěl</dn> has forgotten, <dn>He</dn> has hidden <dn>His</dn> face, <dn>He</dn> shall never see.”

readings.title: A Plea for Divine Justice
readings.subtitle: Arise, O YeHoVaH! O Ěl, lift up Your hand!
readings.text: [Psalm 10:12] Qoph Arise, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>! O <dn>Ěl</dn>, lift up <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> hand! Do not forget the lowly ones. [13] Why do the wrong scorn <dn>Elohim</dn>? <dn>He</dn> has said in his heart, “It is not required.” [14] Rěsh <dn>You</dn> have seen it, for <dn>You</dn> observe trouble and grief, To repay with <dn>Your</dn> hand. The poor commits himself to <dn>You</dn>; <dn>You</dn> are the helper of the fatherless. [15] Shin Break <dn>את</dn> the arm of the wrong one and the evil one; Search out his wrongness that would not be found out. [16] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is Sovereign forever and ever; The nations shall perish from <dn>His</dn> land. [17] Tav <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have heard <dn>את</dn> the desire of the lowly ones; <dn>You</dn> prepare their heart; <dn>You</dn> incline <dn>Your</dn> ear, [18] To defend the fatherless and the downtrodden; So that man who is of the earth no longer oppresses!

readings.title: A Call to Joyful Praise
readings.subtitle: For the Word of YeHoVaH is straight, and all His works are in truth.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:1] Shout for joy in <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the straight! [2] Praise <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> with the lyre; Sing to <dn>Him</dn> with an instrument of ten strings. [3] Sing to <dn>Him</dn> a new song; Play sweetly with a shout of joy. [4] For the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is straight, And all <dn>His</dn> works are in truth, [5] Loving righteousness and right-ruling; The earth is filled with the loving-commitment of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>.

readings.title: The Power of the Creator's Word
readings.subtitle: He spoke, and it came to be; He commanded, and it stood fast.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:6] By the Word of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> the heavens were made, And all their host by the Spirit of <dn>His</dn> mouth, [7] Gathering the waters of the sea together as a heap; Laying up the deep in storehouses. [8] Let all the earth fear <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of <dn>Him</dn>. [9] For <dn>He</dn> spoke, and it came to be; <dn>He</dn> commanded, and it stood fast. [10] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> brings <dn>את</dn> the counsel of the nations to naught; <dn>He</dn> thwarts the plans of the peoples. [11] The counsel of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> stands forever, The plans of <dn>His</dn> heart to all generations.

readings.title: The Lord's Watchful Eye
readings.subtitle: Blessed is the nation whose Elohim is YeHoVaH.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:12] Blessed is the nation whose <dn>Elohim</dn> is <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, The people whom <dn>He</dn> has chosen as <dn>His</dn> own inheritance. [13] <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has looked from the heavens; <dn>He</dn> has seen all the sons of men. [14] <dn>He</dn> looked from <dn>His</dn> dwelling place On all the inhabitants of the earth – [15] <dn>He</dn> who fashions the hearts of them all, <dn>He</dn> who understands all their works. [16] The sovereign is not saved by the multitude of an army; A mighty man is not delivered by great strength. [17] A horse is a vain means of safety; Neither does it rescue any by its great power. [18] See, the eye of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is on those fearing <dn>Him</dn>, On those waiting for <dn>His</dn> loving-commitment, [19] To deliver their being from death, And to keep them alive during scarcity of food.

readings.title: Our Trust and Hope
readings.subtitle: Our help and our shield is He.
readings.text: [Psalm 33:20] Our being has longed for <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; Our help and our shield is <dn>He</dn>. [21] For our heart does rejoice in <dn>Him</dn>, For we have put our trust in <dn>His</dn> set-apart Name. [22] Let <dn>Your</dn> loving-commitment, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, be upon us, Even as we wait for <dn>You</dn>.

readings.title: A Lifelong Refuge
readings.subtitle: My praise is continually of You.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:1] In <dn>You</dn>, O <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>I</dn> have taken refuge; Let me never be ashamed. [2] In <dn>Your</dn> righteousness deliver and rescue me; Incline <dn>Your</dn> ear to me, and save me. [3] Be to me a rock to dwell in, To go into continually. <dn>You</dn> have given the command to save me, For <dn>You</dn> are my rock and my stronghold. [4] Rescue me, O my <dn>Elohim</dn>, Out of the hand of the wrong, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel. [5] For <dn>You</dn> are my expectation, Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, my Trust from my youth. [6] Upon <dn>You</dn> <dn>I</dn> have leaned from my birth; <dn>You</dn> took <dn>את</dn> me out of my mother’s womb. <dn>My</dn> praise is continually of <dn>You</dn>. [7] <dn>I</dn> have become as a wonder to many, But <dn>You</dn> are my strong refuge. [8] <dn>My</dn> mouth is filled with <dn>Your</dn> praise, <dn>Your</dn> splendour, all the day.

readings.title: A Prayer in Old Age
readings.subtitle: Do not forsake me when my strength fails.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:9] Do not cast me off in the time of old age, When my strength fails, do not forsake me. [10] For my enemies have spoken against me. And those who watch for my life Have taken counsel together, [11] Saying, “<dn>Elohim</dn> has forsaken him; Pursue and take him, for there is no one to deliver.” [12] O <dn>Elohim</dn>, do not be far from me; <dn>My</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, hasten to my help! [13] Let those who are adversaries of my life Be ashamed, consumed, Let those who seek my evil, Be covered with reproach and confusion.

readings.title: Continual Praise and Proclamation
readings.subtitle: I shall praise You more and more.
readings.text: [Psalm 71:14] But <dn>I</dn> continually wait, And shall praise <dn>You</dn> more and more. [15] <dn>My</dn> mouth recounts <dn>Your</dn> righteousness <dn>Your</dn> deliverance all the day, Though <dn>I</dn> do not know their numbers. [16] <dn>I</dn> come in the might of the Master <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>; <dn>I</dn> make mention of <dn>Your</dn> righteousness, <dn>Yours</dn> alone. [17] <dn>Elohim</dn>, <dn>You</dn> have taught me from my youth; And to this day <dn>I</dn> declare <dn>Your</dn> wonders. [18] And also when <dn>I</dn> am old and grey, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, do not forsake me, Until <dn>I</dn> declare <dn>את</dn> <dn>Your</dn> strength to a generation, <dn>Your</dn> might to all those who are to come.

readings.title: Praise for God's Greatness
readings.subtitle: O Elohim, who is like You?
readings.text: [Psalm 71:19] For <dn>Your</dn> righteousness, O <dn>Elohim</dn>, is very high, <dn>You</dn> who have done great deeds. O <dn>Elohim</dn>, who is like <dn>You</dn>? [20] <dn>You</dn> who have shown me great and evil distresses, Revive me again and bring me up again From the depths of the earth. [21] <dn>You</dn> increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side. [22] Also with the lyre <dn>I</dn> praise <dn>You</dn> For <dn>Your</dn> trustworthiness, O my <dn>Elohim</dn>! <dn>I</dn> sing to <dn>You</dn> with the lyre, O Set-apart One of Yisra’ěl. [23] <dn>My</dn> lips shout for joy when <dn>I</dn> sing to <dn>You</dn>, Even my being, which <dn>You</dn> have redeemed. [24] <dn>My</dn> tongue, too, utters <dn>Your</dn> righteousness all day long; For those who have been seeking my evil Have been put to shame, Have become abashed.

readings.title: The Secure Dwelling Place
readings.subtitle: He who abides under the shadow of the Almighty.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:1] <dn>He</dn> who dwells in the secret place of the Most High, Who abides under the shadow of the Almighty, [2] <dn>He</dn> is saying of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, “<dn>My</dn> refuge and my stronghold, <dn>My</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn>, in whom <dn>I</dn> trust!” [3] For <dn>He</dn> delivers you from the snare of a trapper, From the destructive pestilence. [4] <dn>He</dn> covers you with <dn>His</dn> feathers, And under <dn>His</dn> wings you take refuge; <dn>His</dn> truth is a shield and armour. [5] <dn>You</dn> are not afraid of the dread by night, Of the arrow that flies by day, [6] Of the pestilence that walks in darkness, Of destruction that ravages at midday. [7] A thousand fall at your side, And ten thousand at your right hand; But it does not come near you. [8] Only with your eyes you look on, And see the reward of the wrong ones.

readings.title: The Promise of Angelic Guard
readings.subtitle: He commands His messengers concerning you.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:9] Because you have made <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> – <dn>My</dn> refuge, the Most High – your dwelling place, [10] No evil befalls you, And a plague does not come near your tent; [11] For <dn>He</dn> commands <dn>His</dn> messengers concerning you, To guard you in all your ways. [12] They bear you up in their hands, Lest you dash your foot against a stone. [13] <dn>You</dn> tread upon lion and cobra, Young lion and serpent you trample under foot.

readings.title: The Lord's Personal Assurance
readings.subtitle: Because he cleaves to Me in love, I deliver him.
readings.text: [Psalm 91:14] <dq>“Because <dn>he</dn> cleaves to <dn>Me</dn> in love, Therefore <dn>I</dn> deliver him; <dn>I</dn> set him on high, Because <dn>he</dn> has known <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> Name.</dq> [15] <dq>“When <dn>he</dn> calls on <dn>Me</dn>, <dn>I</dn> answer him; <dn>I</dn> am with him in distress; <dn>I</dn> deliver him and esteem him.</dq> [16] <dq>“With long life <dn>I</dn> satisfy him, And show him <dn>את</dn> <dn>My</dn> deliverance.”</dq>
